name: perang-petasan-web
description: Perang Petasan: Arena PvP 2D - browser multiplayer top-down bertema kampung

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pp/shared && npm run build -w @pp/server && npm run build -w @pp/client
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @pp/server" "npm run dev -w @pp/client"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @pp/server
scripts.dev:client: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @pp/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pp/shared && npm run typecheck -w @pp/server && npm run typecheck -w @pp/client
